stories.title: Reddit to lock content behind logins to fight scrapers
stories.summary: Reddit announced in a post by co-founder Steve Huffman that the site will gradually become a "logged-in service," offering limited access to visitors without accounts.

stories.title: Chainalysis discloses data breach from "offensive agentic techniques"
stories.summary: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis disclosed a data breach after attackers used "offensive agentic techniques" to access internal systems and tools, exposing customer names, email addresses, user IDs, and organizational roles.

stories.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
stories.summary: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

stories.title: Is a 'beautiful' French election still possible?
stories.summary: Since the violence on the sidelines of the October 17 protests, a spiraling escalation has taken hold in France, raising questions about whether debates can take place in a calm and constructive way ahead of a crucial presidential election.

stories.summary: Evacuees from Oleshky crossed into Ukrainian-held territory Saturday in a major rescue operation after travelling through Belarus during a rare truce brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump. The city of Oleshky has been under Russian occupation since 2022 and…

stories.title: Briton Dart reaches first WTA Tour singles final
stories.summary: A tearful Harriet Dart said it "means the world" to her to qualify for her maiden WTA Tour singles final after battling past to beat China's Sun Xinran at the Guangzhou Open.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.

entries.title: Someone is counter-programming launch day
entries.body: Devolver Digital has a mystery game dated 19 November. Pre-orders have been open since June: Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99, no special edition.
